sections.text: مقدمة

توضح هذه الوثيقة القائمة المرجعية لفحص المعدات I1، التي يجب حملها 
 خارج every three months as indicated by M3 
 in the title block.

The forced draft 
 fan function: pushing atmospheric air through the air preheater dampers through 
 various air ducts and burners into the furnace.

sections.text: After Isolating the Forced Draft Fan Mechanically and Electrically
Check the front / rear bearing and replace the defect bearing.
Check the shaft seals and replace it if needed.
Dismantle the safety cover of the coupling .
Check any leakage from o-rings or gasket

Check gap with feeler for hob separation at 905C 
 points = 1/8 ".

Check hubs alignment with straight edges 905C 
 points
Lubricant hub and sleeve teeth with new grease before cleaning all parts
Check the alignment of the coupling half's and re-alignment it if needed.
Clean the pipes of water cooling by opening the drains.
Check and clean the check valve of water cooling.
Check and retighten all bolts.
Check every part well.

After successful inspection, operate the fan again 
read all available record values and put them in table (2) and compare between the 
values before and after inspection
